cohort: The study included 156 pregnant females over 35 years of age (primiparous, multiparous, and grand multiparous) who gave birth in an obstetrics clinic between January 2018 and January 2024.
finding: Grand multiparity (GM) in females over 35 years old was not found to be a standalone risk factor, showing complication rates similar to other parity groups, although advanced maternal age may be associated with difficulties in GM.
